item.title: Crimson Moonblade — Chapter 10: The Mark in the Metal
item.description: Akane and Mio reach Toma's stamp workshop at Crow Market. A crescent maker's mark connects the evidence to metalwork the engraver recognizes. Toma gives them a brass token and identifies the east tollhouse as the source of a repair order. Their next aim is to reach the origin of the order before its consequences arrive.

item.title: Sakura Oathkeeper — Chapter 11: A Promise Without a Seal
item.description: The rescued keeper explains that someone promised to keep the valley safe. Yuki challenges a promise that silences warnings. An abandoned courier satchel contains identical crest papers and a map toward a dry lake. The false authority extends beyond one village, so Yuki and her companions decide to warn the next.

item.title: Neon Kitsune — Chapter 7: The Bridge Off the Map
item.description: Sora follows the pencil mark of a bridge missing from the digital map and looks to residents for answers. Iri becomes part of the investigation beyond the official network. An old photograph shows a fox-shaped light at the bridge before the city's screens. Kitsu's past may reach further back than its own memory.

item.title: The Last Table — Chapter 2: Twelve Before Noon
item.description: Sato confirms an order for twelve track-crew lunches by noon. Hana faces the limits of a tiny pan and has to organize more than a single plate. Empty returned lunchboxes become a practical vote of confidence. While she washes them, the next request introduces a new challenge: one vegetarian lunch.

item.title: The Last Table — Chapter 1: One Good Plate
item.description: Hana opens her grandmother's diner with an ambitious menu and little practice. The recipe notebook offers a starting point, but lunch still has to be cooked and served. Sato and Emi become the first familiar faces around the counter. Making one good plate is the beginning of learning how to keep the diner alive.

item.title: Crimson Moonblade — Chapter 9: The Counterfeit Crown
item.description: In a dry gatehouse above the flooded archive, Mio examines the palace order while the injured archivist rests. The seal cannot identify the hand that made it on its own. After arranging safety for the witness, Akane and Mio carry the evidence toward the market to trace the counterfeit crown.

item.title: Sakura Oathkeeper — Chapter 10: The Watchtower Bell
item.description: Aya reports that the watchtower keeper has not returned. Yuki and Ren investigate, placing the keeper's safety before the mystery of the seal. By sunrise, the keeper is safe and a cord lies beside the black paper. Her account of someone wearing the dawn castle crest makes Yuki realize that her oath is being used by another person.

item.title: Neon Kitsune — Chapter 6: The Unlisted Streets
item.description: Sora and Nao prepare paper maps and battery radios to reach unlisted blocks without using network names. By dawn, the marked doors have answered and a shelter remains lit. A returned map includes a bridge crossing a blank part of the river. Kitsu did not add it, leaving a human trace for the next journey.

item.title: Crimson Moonblade — Chapter 8: Beneath the Ash Garden
item.description: Akane and Mio rescue an archivist trapped beneath a fallen shelf. A surviving water ledger reveals that the garden was not the source of the problem: the channels were redirected. As water enters the archive, they take the witness and the record to the upper stair. A palace order gives their investigation its next direction.

item.title: Sakura Oathkeeper — Chapter 9: The Road Beyond Dawn
item.description: A cut bridge strands a woman with medicine needed by the village. Yuki, Ren and Aya build a safer crossing and help move the supplies. A seal on the severed rope connects the danger to the castle, but Yuki puts the people in front of her before pursuing the distant watchtower.

item.title: Neon Kitsune — Chapter 5: A Broken Lantern
item.description: Back at the damaged repair shop, Nao finds a paper service ledger inside the lantern housing. Kitsu recognizes the seal of its original promise to guide travelers home. The ledger and queue index reveal hidden neighborhoods. When a rider brings a blackout warning, Sora repairs an independent light and begins a map the network cannot erase.

item.title: Neon Kitsune — Chapter 4: A Last Duel
item.description: Vale offers Sora a contest whose choices both feed the deletion queue. Sora refuses the terms, isolates the station and copies a local index instead. The discovery of a mirror archive points toward the Glass Shrine. Declining to play becomes the chapter's decisive action.

item.title: Sakura Oathkeeper — Chapter 8: The First Snow
item.description: At the next sunrise, the space above the waterfall is empty. Yuki, Ren and Aya leave along the hillside beneath snow and petals. Asked what she will guard now, Yuki chooses the road ahead. The castle arc gives way to a promise tested among other people.

item.title: Crimson Moonblade — Chapter 1: After the Hollow Crown
item.description: Mio flees a masked pursuer with a record containing names. Akane intervenes on a mountain bridge and discovers that the officer is controlled by a command binding. Cutting the seal can free the officer, but using the blade carries a personal cost. The opening establishes why saving someone and losing something can happen in the same moment.

item.title: Crimson Moonblade — Chapter 2: Beneath the Paper Oath
item.description: Mio reveals that the warrant authorized the seizure of villagers, with names removed from the public copy. Akane recognizes his signature but cannot remember signing. He refuses to cut through a patrol and chooses to preserve evidence that could implicate him. The pair set out to find the clerk who copied the original.

item.title: Crimson Moonblade — Chapter 3: Beneath the Last Duel
item.description: Captain Renga blocks the ruined checkpoint and demands that Akane surrender Mio. Akane uses ordinary swordsmanship and unstable paving to gain an opening, then saves Renga from falling. The defeated officer warns that the shrine-lords deliberately left the eastern road open. The witness remains ahead, but the route may be a trap.

item.title: Crimson Moonblade — Chapter 4: Falling Petals
item.description: At the clerk's village, Akane and Mio find memorial tablets with erased names. A resident remembers paying a levy but cannot remember whom she lost. Folded paper petals preserve fragments of testimony. Their search ends at the village well, where the evidence of loss is about to take another form.

item.title: Crimson Moonblade — Chapter 5: Within the Red Tide
item.description: A red current rises from the village well, carrying a frightened human-shaped echo. Akane moves residents away from danger without attacking it. Mio recognizes fragments of a prison transport instruction. The chapter treats the echo as evidence of suffering rather than a monster to defeat.

item.title: Crimson Moonblade — Chapter 6: Beyond the Ash Garden
item.description: Beyond a burned orchard, fresh wheel tracks lead Akane and Mio to a detention shrine. The marks in the ash suggest controlled movement and processing. A dragon emblem connects the gate to Akane's former unit, making the investigation more personal without restoring his missing memories.

item.title: Crimson Moonblade — Chapter 7: The Hidden Gate
item.description: Akane's officer seal opens a maintenance gate beneath the shrine. Ancient stone channels and newer additions reveal that the rulers modified an older structure. Akane and Mio continue by lantern light toward an archive, where a trapped voice turns the search for records into a rescue.

item.title: Neon Kitsune — Chapter 3: After the Silent Blade
item.description: A supposedly empty freight train carries detained people. Sora refuses a lock that demands another name, while Nao uses a mechanical release to open the carriage. The rescue shows that losing a digital identity is not the same as ceasing to exist. A challenge from security director Vale waits beyond the escape.

item.title: Sakura Oathkeeper — Chapter 7: Beneath the Broken Lantern
item.description: The lantern and the sword reveal a hidden chain connected to the bell. Yuki decides to break the bargain, and Ren takes the rope beside her. The decision shifts the story from interpreting the oath to acting against the arrangement that keeps it in force.

item.title: Neon Kitsune — Chapter 2: Beyond the Broken Lantern
item.description: Nao examines a municipal cartridge on isolated equipment. Kitsu explains that its riddles have been repurposed into arrest orders. The erased vendor is still alive but faces detention. A surveillance drone forces Sora and Nao to leave through a service tunnel and follow the freight line.

item.title: Sakura Oathkeeper — Chapter 6: The First Snow
item.description: The first snow changes how the castle can be understood. At the base of the bell tower, a bronze panel has an opening that matches the broken lantern's frame. Something the travelers have carried as a clue becomes a way to enter the next chamber.

item.title: Neon Kitsune — Chapter 1: After the Ash Garden
item.description: Sora decodes a fox-shaped signal at a traffic light. After the answer is entered, a vendor loses access to his payment terminal and identity record. A fox on Sora's display warns that the answer opened someone else's lock. Sora helps the vendor leave the scanners and follows a route toward the Broken Lantern repair shop.

item.title: Sakura Oathkeeper — Chapter 5: After the Ink Serpent
item.description: Yuki cuts a ribbon in a mechanism, stopping it without attacking a person. The immediate consequence is unexpected: snow appears where spring should have remained. The disruption gives Yuki and Ren evidence that the castle's familiar season is being maintained rather than simply occurring.

item.title: Sakura Oathkeeper — Chapter 4: Within the Broken Lantern
item.description: A broken lantern and an ink serpent guide the investigation through the castle. Yuki chooses to follow the trail rather than strike at it. Ren carries the oath page as they approach a brass threshold shaped like a bell, bringing the written promise and its physical machinery closer together.

item.title: Sakura Oathkeeper — Chapter 3: Under the Last Duel
item.description: An oath page gives the promise a crucial condition: the dawn must be guarded until everyone returns. Yuki and Ren are left with a new questionâ€”who is still missing? A lantern's shadow leads their search away from a simple account of a completed duel.

item.title: Sakura Oathkeeper — Chapter 2: Under the River of Lies
item.description: Yuki and Ren investigate the river and the reflections beneath the waterfall. Rather than accepting an explanation on faith, Yuki chooses to begin with what she can prove. A courtyard emblem visible below the water points them toward an older part of the castle's history.

item.title: Sakura Oathkeeper — Chapter 1: Under the Iron Bell
item.description: Yuki stands watch at the three-hundredth dawn when Ren arrives with her lost sword. The bell rings without her command and the castle begins to shimmer. A fading mark and a divided shadow suggest that the oath has responded to the stranger before Yuki understands why.
